hook.en: Press the top cover of a thick book sideways and the pages slant: its shape changes. Take a ball deep under water and it shrinks: its volume changes. Each needs its own modulus.
hook.kn: ದಪ್ಪ ಪುಸ್ತಕದ ಮೇಲ್ಭಾಗವನ್ನು ಪಕ್ಕಕ್ಕೆ ತಳ್ಳಿದರೆ ಪುಟಗಳು ಓರೆಯಾಗುತ್ತವೆ: ಆಕಾರ ಬದಲಾಗುತ್ತದೆ. ಚೆಂಡನ್ನು ಆಳದ ನೀರಿಗೆ ಒಯ್ದರೆ ಅದು ಕುಗ್ಗುತ್ತದೆ: ಗಾತ್ರ ಬದಲಾಗುತ್ತದೆ.

objectives.en: Define the bulk modulus B and compressibility

narration.en: Press the top cover of a thick book sideways and the pages slant: its shape changes. Take a ball deep under water and it shrinks: its volume changes. Each needs its own modulus.
narration.kn: ದಪ್ಪ ಪುಸ್ತಕದ ಮೇಲ್ಭಾಗವನ್ನು ಪಕ್ಕಕ್ಕೆ ತಳ್ಳಿದರೆ ಪುಟಗಳು ಓರೆಯಾಗುತ್ತವೆ: ಆಕಾರ ಬದಲಾಗುತ್ತದೆ. ಚೆಂಡನ್ನು ಆಳದ ನೀರಿಗೆ ಒಯ್ದರೆ ಅದು ಕುಗ್ಗುತ್ತದೆ: ಗಾತ್ರ ಬದಲಾಗುತ್ತದೆ.

body.en: When a tangential force F acts on a face of area A, the body changes shape. Shear modulus G = shearing stress / shearing strain = (F/A)/θ. For most materials G is about one-third of Y.
body.kn: ಸ್ಪರ್ಶಕ ಬಲ ಒಂದು ಮುಖದ ಮೇಲೆ ವರ್ತಿಸಿದಾಗ ಆಕಾರ ಬದಲಾಗುತ್ತದೆ. ಶಿಯರ್ ಗುಣಾಂಕ G = ಶಿಯರ್ ಪ್ರತಿಬಲ ÷ ಶಿಯರ್ ವಿಕೃತಿ. ಸಾಮಾನ್ಯವಾಗಿ G ≈ Y/3.

say.en: Fix the bottom face of a block and push its top face sideways with a tangential force F. The block changes shape, not size.
Shear strain is Δx over L, which equals the angle θ. Shear modulus G is shearing stress over shearing strain.
Now squeeze a body equally from all sides with an extra pressure p. Its volume falls by ΔV.
Water has B about 2.2 times ten to the 9 pascal. At 100 atmospheres its volume falls by only about 0.46 percent.
Solids are the least compressible, liquids next, and gases the most.

narration.en: Fix the bottom face of a block and push its top face sideways with a tangential force F. The block changes shape, not size. Shear strain is Δx over L, which equals the angle θ. Shear modulus G is shearing stress over shearing strain. Now squeeze a body equally from all sides with an extra pressure p. Its volume falls by ΔV. Water has B about 2.2 times ten to the 9 pascal. At 100 atmospheres its volume falls by only about 0.46 percent. Solids are the least compressible, liquids next, and gases the most.

body.en: When a body is put under a uniform extra pressure p, its volume falls by ΔV. Bulk modulus B = −p/(ΔV/V); the minus sign makes B positive. Compressibility k = 1/B. Solids are the least compressible and gases the most: steel has B ≈ 1.6 × 10¹¹ Pa, water ≈ 2.2 × 10⁹ Pa.
body.kn: ಏಕರೂಪ ಒತ್ತಡ p ಹೆಚ್ಚಿದಾಗ ಗಾತ್ರ ΔV ಕಡಿಮೆಯಾಗುತ್ತದೆ. ಗಾತ್ರ ಗುಣಾಂಕ B = −p/(ΔV/V). ಸಂಪೀಡ್ಯತೆ k = 1/B. ಘನಗಳು ಕಡಿಮೆ, ಅನಿಲಗಳು ಹೆಚ್ಚು ಸಂಪೀಡ್ಯ.

homework.en: Find the fractional fall in volume of a steel ball (B = 1.6 × 10¹¹ Pa) taken to a depth where the extra pressure is 1.6 × 10⁷ Pa.

narration.en: Recap. G = shearing stress / shearing strain: change of shape. B = −p/(ΔV/V): change of volume. Compressibility = 1/B; gases are the most compressible.
narration.kn: ಪುನರಾವರ್ತನೆ. G = ಶಿಯರ್ ಪ್ರತಿಬಲ ÷ ಶಿಯರ್ ವಿಕೃತಿ: ಆಕಾರ ಬದಲಾವಣೆ. B = −p/(ΔV/V): ಗಾತ್ರ ಬದಲಾವಣೆ. ಸಂಪೀಡ್ಯತೆ = 1/B; ಅನಿಲಗಳು ಹೆಚ್ಚು ಸಂಪೀಡ್ಯ.
